title: Feedback on a recommendation
description: Input of FeedbackService (NOT-06, D-044). Used by the frontend and the Slack module. It never changes the score by itself. The comment is untrusted input.

user_email.description: Must belong to a Firebase user with the analyst or admin role

proposed_level.description: Result of the ↑↓ arrows (one level per click). Required when verdict = wrong_priority

proposed_score.description: Optional, for users who want precision

ticket_itop_id.description: Optional: iTop id of the ticket the user acted on (ticket.itop_id of the event). When present, ticket-level effects (stop_suggestions, comments in iTop, false positive) only touch that ticket; absent, null or empty (an event delivered before iTop created the ticket) keeps them on every ticket of the assessment. Backward compatible.
